description.text: Across a burning battlefield at dusk, ragged banners, broken siege engines, and trenches glow beneath drifting smoke. The huge black dragon sweeps into the scene from the left, wings spread wide, its scales catching orange firelight. The knight in battered plate armour is braced low on its back, shield arm tight, cloak snapping behind. Embers stream past as the dragon holds a low, fast line just above the flames.
The burning battlefield is revealed under a ceiling of smoke, with firelight pulsing across broken ground.
Heavy wingbeats thud through the air, undercut by a distant fire roar.
The black dragon glides low over the flames; the knight braces against the saddle as embers streak past.
Wind rushes across armour and harness.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

Beside the dragon's neck, the knight leans forward in the saddle, dented pauldrons and scarred gauntlets rattling with each wingbeat. The dragon's scaled neck and a spur of horn fill the background, firelight sliding over black plates. The knight shouts into the wind, jaw tight, eyes fixed ahead; smoke tears past in fast ribbons. The rider's urgent posture and the beast's massive motion dominate the view.
The knight leans forward and shouts into the wind; the dragon's neck fills the background.
Armour plates clatter and harness leather creaks.
Firelight flickers across the knight's battered breastplate and the dragon's glossy scales.
Rushing wind rises over the wingbeats.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

From the side, the dragon banks hard over a collapsing siege line. The battlefield wheels beneath them: shattered towers, burning trebuchets, and lines of smoke. The dragon's wings tilt nearly vertical, black scales washed with furnace-orange light, while the knight grips the saddle and leans into the turn. Sparks and ash spiral off the turning body, and the wider siege line opens out below with a dangerous drop beneath them.
The dragon banks hard over the collapsing siege line, wings tilted; the knight holds on.
The wider battlefield wheels into view below, marked by burning siege engines and smoke.
A wing buffet cracks over the crackling fire.
Sparks and ash spiral off the dragon's turning scales.
The camera arcs around the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

The dragon climbs out of the smoke. The knight is silhouetted against the flames, one hand on the saddle horn, battered armour dark against the glow. The dragon's wings beat upward in heavy strokes, carrying them clear of the smoke layer. Below, the burning battlefield spreads out in ember-lit patches, receding beneath them. The last light catches the dragon's black scales and the knight's helm before the pair rise into clearer air.
The dragon climbs out of the smoke, the knight silhouetted against the flames.
The burning battlefield recedes below in ember-lit patches.
Wingbeats fade under a distant fire roar.
The pair rise into clearer air, scales and helm catching the last firelight.
The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed.
